claims.cytotoxic_mechanism: Tamibarotene is a selective RARalpha agonist that kills only the small subset of AML lines with a RARA superenhancer and high RARA mRNA, so at 2.5 uM it produces selective, RARA-dependent differentiation/apoptosis rather than broad cytotoxicity.
